question.en: Which area does the BenchCouncil annual table assign to Chain-of-Thought Prompting?
question.zh: BenchCouncil 年度表把 Chain-of-Thought Prompting 归入哪个领域？

explanation.en: Chain-of-Thought Prompting appears in the LLM area of the official annual table.
explanation.zh: Chain-of-Thought Prompting 位于官方年度表的“大语言模型”领域。
